title: System overview
description: Inspect Windows build, uptime, memory, storage, Defender, restart state, and privilege context.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Unified diagnostics
description: Collect bounded OS, power, battery, hotfix, Secure Boot, Defender, and reboot evidence.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Health findings
description: Summarize immediate storage, restart, and security warnings with recommendations.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Storage overview
description: Inspect local volumes, used space, free space, and pressure thresholds.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Cleanup assessment
description: Discover bounded cleanup targets and estimated reclaimable space without deleting anything.
argumentHelp: Refresh: rescan all supported cleanup targets.

title: Security posture
description: Inspect Defender, firewall, encryption, Secure Boot, TPM, UAC, and related controls.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Balanced hardening assessment
description: Compare the balanced hardening profile with current machine state before any change.
argumentHelp: ProfileId: balanced, strict, or hailmary.

title: Apply balanced hardening
description: Apply the bounded balanced hardening profile through typed plans, policy, preview, journal, and recovery.
argumentHelp: ProfileId: balanced. Preview is mandatory before apply.

title: Apply strict hardening
description: Apply stricter privacy and security controls with compatibility warnings and recovery evidence.
argumentHelp: ProfileId: strict. Review compatibility warnings.

title: Hail Mary hardening
description: Execute the intentionally destructive hardening profile. This may reduce compatibility and recovery can be incomplete.
argumentHelp: Requires Critical policy permission and the exact unsafe acknowledgement.

title: Strict privacy profile
description: Apply reversible consumer-feature, diagnostic-data, cross-device, and content-delivery restrictions.
argumentHelp: ProfileId: balanced, strict, or maximum.

title: Maximum privacy profile
description: Apply the broadest privacy profile, including high-impact restrictions and compatibility tradeoffs.
argumentHelp: Requires Critical policy permission and exact acknowledgement.

title: Safe deep clean
description: Clean bounded caches and temporary data using the donor-safe profile and coordinated service restoration.
argumentHelp: ProfileId: donor-safe-deep-clean.

title: Create weekly health window
description: Create a revisioned weekly maintenance window from the health template.
argumentHelp: Set StartAt to an ISO-8601 timestamp appropriate for your locale.

title: Search Windows updates
description: Search Windows Update Agent results without installing or hiding updates.
argumentHelp: Optional criteria are supported by the headless contract.

title: Undoable operations
description: Inspect completed operations with compensators, receipts, and recovery eligibility.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Network summary
description: Inspect adapters, addressing, routes, proxy, DNS, listeners, and connectivity.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Measure network endpoints
description: Run bounded latency and TCP reachability samples against explicit endpoints.
argumentHelp: Edit TargetHosts, sample count, timeout, and port as needed.

title: WLAN survey
description: Inspect local wireless interfaces, profiles, visible networks, signal, radio, and security state.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Workspace snapshot
description: Inspect monitoring, file workspaces, layouts, package admission, devices, and local integrations.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Window inventory
description: Inspect top-level windows, processes, monitor association, bounds, state, and topmost status.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Browser workspace
description: Inspect local browser profiles, windows, and extension-permission risk without reading browsing content.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Installed applications
description: Inspect desktop and Store application inventory with uninstall metadata and source classification.
argumentHelp: IncludeStoreApps and Refresh are optional booleans.

title: Reset display overrides
description: Remove EDID overrides and graphics topology caches. Displays may disconnect, reorder, or require reboot.
argumentHelp: Requires AllowDisplayOverrideReset, Critical permission, and exact acknowledgement.

title: Xbox Full Screen Experience
description: Apply hidden feature IDs and OEM DeviceForm changes through exact-hash verified ViVeTool bytes.
argumentHelp: Provide the exact local ViVeTool path and 64-character SHA-256.

title: Legacy Unsafe profile
description: Execute an explicitly selected destructive one-click profile through the typed unsafe mutation plane.
argumentHelp: Choose a profile ID. Critical policy and exact acknowledgement are mandatory.

title: Capability evidence cards
description: Search capability cards that connect operator outcomes to source records and risk boundaries.
argumentHelp: Query is optional.

title: Reports and receipts
description: Inspect JSON, Markdown, HTML, logs, operation journals, and integrity evidence.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: Hardware inventory
description: Inspect bounded computer, OS, firmware, CPU, memory, graphics, disk, network, battery, and TPM state with sensitive identifiers hashed by default.
argumentHelp: Keep IncludeSensitiveIdentifiers false for shareable reports.

title: External monitor controls
description: Inspect DDC/CI brightness and contrast support for physical monitors without changing values.
argumentHelp: No arguments required. Unsupported VCP features are reported explicitly.

title: Window search
description: Find top-level windows with bounded fuzzy matching over process and title metadata.
argumentHelp: Set Query to a title or process fragment and Limit to 1..200.

title: Explorer session
description: Capture current canonical local Explorer folder locations for review before saving or restoring a session.
argumentHelp: No arguments required.

title: AppX runtime inventory
description: Map running processes to supported Windows package identities without mutating applications.
argumentHelp: IncludeUnpackaged is optional; Limit must be 1..2048.

title: Archive safety inspection
description: Inspect ZIP, AppX, MSIX, bundle, and NuGet containers for traversal, collisions, symlinks, expansion, and compression bombs without extraction.
argumentHelp: Replace LiteralPath with an existing local ZIP-container file.

title: Accessibility tree snapshot
description: Inspect a bounded UI Automation tree with visible text redacted by default.
argumentHelp: Use a specific ProcessId where possible. IncludeText should remain false for shareable evidence.

title: Winhance maximum profile
description: Execute the broad Winhance-derived hardening, debloat, AppX, service, task, privacy, update, cleanup, and capability reduction composition through WinCare's typed Legacy Unsafe plane.
argumentHelp: Requires all applicable policy gates, preview receipt, explicit Apply, UAC where required, and the exact unsafe acknowledgement.

title: Disk-pressure cleanup
description: Assess free-space pressure and preview a bounded cleanup plan over canonical WinCare targets.
argumentHelp: Auto selects Conservative, Balanced, or Emergency from current free space. Apply remains separately gated.

title: Winapp2 cleanup admission
description: Parse FileKey-only Winapp2 rules into an exact, size-bounded file manifest; registry and broad-scan directives are rejected.
argumentHelp: Use a local .ini or .txt file no larger than 2 MiB.

title: Safe local file preview
description: Inspect local files and directories with bounded, redacted, non-executing format profiles.
argumentHelp: Active content is never executed; text remains excluded unless explicitly requested.

title: Preview-handler assessment
description: Inventory registered COM preview handlers and signature state without loading them.
argumentHelp: Server paths are represented by hashes; no handler DLL is loaded.
